Methodology Notes

Runs per over uses total team runs and legal balls as overs. Bowler economy uses bowler-attributable runs only: runs_of_bat + wides + no-balls, excluding byes and leg-byes. Wides and no-balls are treated as non-legal deliveries. Boundary percentage is deliveries with runs_of_bat equal to 4 or 6 divided by all recorded deliveries. Dot balls are deliveries with runs_of_bat = 0 and extras = 0. Bowler wickets exclude run outs; team wicket totals use all recorded player_dismissed values. Empty dismissal fields are treated as not applicable.
